title: Several Citizens Arrested in Kerman Province on Security-Related Charges
content:
According to HRANA, citing ISNA, several citizens have been arrested by security forces in Kerman Province.

On Thursday, October 15, the Prosecutor General and Revolutionary Prosecutor of Kerman announced that these citizens had been arrested by IRGC Intelligence agents. He claimed that the detainees were members of a group affiliated with opponents of the government.

Elaborating on the allegations against these individuals, Mehdi Bakhshi stated: “Through organized connections, members of this group were pursuing activities deemed to be against national security, including setting fire to buildings and engaging in propaganda activities aimed at advancing the objectives of counterrevolutionary groups.”

The report provided no further details, including the identities or number of those arrested, the exact dates of their arrests, or their current whereabouts.
snippet: According to HRANA, citing ISNA, several citizens have been arrested by security forces in Kerman Province.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Ata Ghobadi Arrested in Kamyaran
content:
According to HRANA, citing Kolbar news, on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, Ata Ghobadi was arrested by agents of the Ministry of Intelligence in Kamyaran, Kurdistan Province.

According to the report, Ministry of Intelligence agents entered and searched his home before arresting him without presenting a judicial warrant.

At the time of this report, no information is available regarding the reasons for Ata Ghobadi’s arrest, the charges against him, or his whereabouts.
snippet: According to HRANA, citing Kolbar news, on Wednesday, October 14, 2026, Ata Ghobadi was arrested by agents of the Ministry of Intelligence in Kamyaran, Kurdistan Province.

title: Kaveh Montazeri Arrested in Kamyaran

title: Mousa-Alreza Zoghi Moghaddam Arrested in Mashhad
content:
Based on information received by HRANA, Zoghi Moghaddam was arrested by security forces at his residence on Tuesday, October 13, 2026. The arrest was reportedly carried out with violence.

An informed source close to his family confirmed the news to HRANA, stating that Zoghi Moghaddam was transferred to Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad following his arrest. He is facing a charge of “assembly and collusion against national security.” The source added that after his family made inquiries regarding his temporary release, they were informed that bail had been set at 400 million tomans.

According to the source, a summons had previously been issued to Zoghi Moghaddam, but he was unaware of it.

At the time of this report, no information was available regarding the specific acts underlying the charge against him.
snippet: Based on information received by HRANA, Zoghi Moghaddam was arrested by security forces at his residence on Tuesday, October 13, 2026. The arrest was reportedly carried out with violence.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Political Prisoner Varisheh Moradi Sentenced to Death for the Second Time
content:
According to HRANA, citing Emtedad, political prisoner Varisheh Moradi has once again been sentenced to death.

Amir Sajjadi, one of Moradi’s lawyers, provided details of the ruling, stating: “Following the receipt of a notice from Branch 15 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court, one of Ms. Moradi’s lawyers appeared before the court today, October 14, 2026, and was formally notified of the verdict. According to the ruling, which can be appealed to the Supreme Court within 20 days, Ms. Moradi has once again been sentenced to death on charges of membership in a rebel group.”

Keyvan Azizi, another of Moradi’s lawyers, also criticized the ruling, stating: “This verdict was issued despite the fact that the previous death sentence handed down by Branch 15 of the Revolutionary Court against Varisheh Moradi had been overturned by the Supreme Court due to serious concerns regarding the investigation. Unfortunately, without conducting the investigations requested by the Supreme Court, the same branch merely changed the designation of the charge and once again sentenced her to death for membership in a rebel group.”
snippet: According to HRANA, citing Emtedad, political prisoner Varisheh Moradi has once again been sentenced to death.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: January 2026 Protests: Abolfazl Damanjani Sentenced to 15 Years in Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Abolfazl Damanjani, one of those arrested during the protests in January of last year, has been sentenced to imprisonment.

Based on information received by HRANA, Branch 5 of the Mashhad Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Yazdankhah, sentenced Damanjani to a total of 15 years in prison on charges of “assembly and collusion against national security, propaganda against the regime, and acting against national security.”

The verdict was issued and communicated to him some time ago.

Abolfazl Damanjani, a resident of Mashhad, was arrested by security agents at his workplace on January 10, 2026, and transferred to Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad.

At the time of this report, no information was available regarding the details of the verdict or the specific prison term imposed for each charge.

title: Hamzeh Savari Launches Hunger Strike at Ghezel Hesar Prison in Karaj
content:
According to HRANA, Hamzeh Savari Laftah has launched a hunger strike at Ghezel Hesar Prison in Karaj.

Based on information received by HRANA, the political prisoner began a week-long hunger strike today, Wednesday, October 14, in solidarity with Mokhtar Al-Bushokeh. Al-Bushokeh has been on hunger strike since Tuesday, October 6, protesting prison authorities’ failure to fulfill their promise to transfer him from Arak Prison to Sheiban Prison in Ahvaz. He is currently being held in a solitary confinement cell at Arak Prison.

Savari was arrested by security forces on September 2, 2005, when he was just 16 years old. He was sentenced to death by the Ahvaz Revolutionary Court on charges of “corruption on earth, moharebeh (enmity against God), and acting against national security.” His death sentence was eventually commuted to life imprisonment. He has now spent more than 21 years behind bars.
snippet: According to HRANA, Hamzeh Savari Laftah has launched a hunger strike at Ghezel Hesar Prison in Karaj.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Ali-Sina Mostafavi Executed in Kerman
content:
According to HRANA, citing Mizan News Agency, the death sentence of Ali-Sina Mostafavi was carried out in Kerman.

The Judiciary’s Media Center claimed that on March 24, 2026, Mostafavi opened fire in Azadi Square in Kerman, injuring a civilian and a young girl. According to the same source, he also fired shots at conscript soldiers and passing vehicles on April 21, 2026, and on two occasions fired toward the Kerman–Mahan Highway Police.

The center described Mostafavi as a “monarchist” and stated that he had participated in the protests of January 2026, during which he allegedly sent videos and photographs to media outlets based outside Iran. It further claimed that during the war, he filmed locations struck by projectiles and provided the footage to these outlets.

According to the report, following Mostafavi’s identification and arrest, security personnel searched his hiding place and discovered firearms, ammunition, and Molotov cocktails.
snippet: According to HRANA, citing Mizan News Agency, the death sentence of Ali-Sina Mostafavi was carried out in Kerman.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Reza Maroufi Aghdam Arrested by Security Forces in Bukan
content:
According to HRANA, citing Kurdpa, Reza Maroufi Aghdam was arrested by security forces in Bukan.

According to the report, on Tuesday, October 13, 2026, security forces raided his home without presenting a judicial warrant and arrested him.

At the time of this report, the reasons for Mr. Maroufi Aghdam’s arrest and his whereabouts remain unknown. Security forces have not provided any explanation regarding his detention.

Furthermore, the 58-year-old man has been denied access to legal counsel and deprived of the right to contact or receive visits from his family.
snippet: According to HRANA, citing Kurdpa, Reza Maroufi Aghdam was arrested by security forces in Bukan.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Report on the Execution of Four Prisoners in Tabriz Prison
content:
According to HRANA, citing Iran Human Rights Organization, four prisoners were executed in Tabriz Central Prison on the morning of Wednesday, September 30, 2026.

The prisoners have been identified as Milad Safari, 39, a father of two; Ebrahim Khazali; Ahmadreza Zivari, 47; and Sadegh Hatami, 41.

According to the report, Milad Safari and Ebrahim Khazali had been sentenced to death in separate murder cases. Mr. Safari, a father of two, had been in detention for five years, while Mr. Khazali had been held for eight years.

Additionally, Ahmadreza Zivari and Sadegh Hatami had been sentenced to death in separate cases involving drug-related offenses. Before his arrest approximately two years ago, Mr. Zivari worked as a passenger driver. Mr. Hatami worked as a school transport driver for children before his arrest and had been imprisoned for approximately four years.

As of the time of this report, the executions have not been officially announced by prison officials or the relevant authorities.
snippet: According to HRANA, citing Iran Human Rights Organization, four prisoners were executed in Tabriz Central Prison on the morning of Wednesday, September 30, 2026.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Death Sentence of Amirhassan Akbari-Monfared Upheld by Supreme Court
content:
According to HRANA, Branch 41 of the Supreme Court has upheld the death sentence of political prisoner Amirhassan Akbari-Monfared and communicated to him in prison on October 11, 2026. In July of this year, he was sentenced to death by Branch 15 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Abolghasem Salavati, on charges of baghi (armed rebellion) through membership in the People’s Mojahedin Organization of Iran (PMOI/MEK).

Amirhassan Akbari-Monfared was arrested alongside his father, Mohammad Akbari-Monfared, his brother Amirhossein, and his sister Zeinab by Ministry of Intelligence agents in Karaj during the winter of 2025. Some time later, three members of his family were released on bail.

No information has yet been obtained regarding the specific charges brought against the other members of his family. However, a source familiar with the situation of these political defendants previously told HRANA that they were facing security-related charges.

Mohammad Akbari-Monfared, aged approximately 58, Amirhossein Akbari-Monfared, 33, Zeinab Akbari-Monfared, 30, and Amirhassan Akbari-Monfared are all residents of Karaj.

title: Mehdi Mirzaei Executed in Hamedan Prison on Non-Political Charges
content:
HRANA has confirmed the identity of the prisoner, who was hanged at dawn today, Monday, October 12, as Mehdi Mirzaei.

According to information obtained by HRANA, Mr. Mirzaei had previously been arrested on charges related to non-political offenses and was subsequently sentenced to death by judicial authorities.

As of the time of this report, the execution has not been officially announced by prison officials or the relevant authorities.

Between October 10, 2025, and October 8, 2026, HRANA documented at least 2,003 executions across Iran, based on 1,857 reports, representing an increase of approximately 29% compared to the previous reporting period. During the same period, HRANA also documented 230 death sentences. For more detailed statistics and analysis of executions in Iran, read HRANA’s latest comprehensive report.
snippet: HRANA has confirmed the identity of the prisoner, who was hanged at dawn today, Monday, October 12, as Mehdi Mirzaei.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Escalating Armed Violence in Southeastern Iran: At Least 63 Armed Incidents in Six Months
content: HRANA – At least 63 armed incidents were recorded across Iran’s southeastern provinces of Sistan and Baluchestan and Kerman between March 31 and October 10, 2026, amid a sharp escalation in armed violence in the region. According to local and unofficial reports, the incidents left at least 94 people dead and 33 injured, while official sources reported 87 fatalities and 10 injuries. The pace of violence accelerated significantly in recent weeks, with 18 incidents recorded in just the final 18 days of the reporting period, surpassing the total for any previous full month. The escalation has also been accompanied by a shift in the nature of confrontations, from targeted shootings and attacks on patrol vehicles to coordinated ambushes, roadside bombings, and the reported use of rocket-propelled grenades and heavier weaponry.
